tools.name: find_fashion_items
tools.description: Use this only when the user has supplied a photo, screenshot, direct image URL, social post, blog, or product page containing fashion to identify, visually match, or shop. A visual source is required. Pass that source as given; Remode resolves supported public links itself. It cannot receive a file

tools.description: Use this when the user provides one specific fashion product-page URL and asks whether the same item is available elsewhere, cheaper, second-hand, or from another retailer. tools.name: watch_item
tools.description: Create or refresh an account-linked Hunt for a specific fashion product URL. Call this only when the shopper clearly wants Remode to keep watching this item over time: keep watching or looking, watch it for a lower price or second-hand options, alert or notify me, tell me or let me know when, start

tools.description: Read the linked user's active Hunts, stored requested criteria and recorded historical alerts. tools.name: update_watch
tools.description: Edit criteria for an existing Hunt using its returned watch_id. Read get_watch_updates first. Use operation add to preserve existing criteria when the shopper asks for another lane; remove to drop a lane; replace only for an explicit complete change. Removing lower_price also deletes its saved price

tools.name: stop_watching_item
tools.description: Stop an existing Remode Hunt. Use only after the user asks to stop tracking an item. Requires the stable watch_id returned by Remode.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_watch_updates" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Read the linked user's active Hunts, stored requested criteria and recorded historical alerts. Use before editing an existing Hunt to preserve unmentioned terms…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?platform=mcp_registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_fashion_items, check_price, watch_item · Private data: find_fashion_items, watch_item · Public sink: find_fashion_items, check_price, watch_item · Destructive: check_price, update_watch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_fashion_items, check_price, watch_item · Private data: find_fashion_items, watch_item · Public sink: find_fashion_items, check_price, watch_item · Destructive: check_price, update_watch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
